answer: Every genesis bond is funded from an origin address, an opal mark on the ledger, no umber shadow to hide in. Group identities by funding origin; each epoch, every identity pays 500 POA times its group size squared, so the ripple of one added fake raises the fee for all. At epoch close, unpaid identities go dormant three epochs and all fees are burned. One operator funding 1.000 fakes from one origin pays 500 x 1.000^2 = 500.000.000 POA per identity (500.000.000.000 total) vs 500 POA for one honest identity. Honest limitation: small honest teams sharing one wallet also pay the escalated fee.
